sourceTitle: How to See the British Museum in Four Visits
description: "How to See the British Museum in Four Visits" by W. Blanchard Jerrold is a guidebook written in the mid-19th century. The book provides a structured approach for visitors to the British Museum, detailing what can be seen during each of four distinct visits.
